results.question: How do Microsoft Teams Calling Plans work and which nonexistent cmdlet enables them?

proofFacts.proposition: Microsoft Teams Calling Plans provide PSTN connectivity for Teams Phone, enabling users to make and receive external phone calls.
This solution is the simplest option that connects Teams Phone to the PSTN for external calling.

explanationContext.exactText: Document: Microsoft Teams Calling Plans Heading Path: Microsoft Teams Calling Plans Microsoft Teams Calling Plans provide PSTN connectivity for Teams Phone, enabling users to make and receive external phone calls. This article helps you choose the right Calling Plan, understand licensing requirements, and purchase Calling Plans for your organization. This solution is the simplest option that connects Teams Phone to the PSTN for external calling. To find out if Microsoft Teams Calling Plans are available in your area, see Country and region availability. If Teams Calling Plans aren't available in your area, Microsoft provides other PSTN connectivity options. For more information on all PSTN connectivity options, see PSTN connectivity options. After reading this article, see Set up Microsoft Calling Plans.
